tasks.title: Qualify workspace and engine
tasks.acceptance: Doctor and preflight run; actual Editor and Game build result saved; missing prerequisites explicit.

tasks.title: Prove independent recovery
tasks.acceptance: Backup restored into a separate directory with LFS payloads, hashes verified, project can build.

tasks.title: Own and package a test map
tasks.acceptance: An authored .umap is the configured startup map; staged Win64 executable starts without editor.

tasks.title: Ground control and camera route
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard and controller cross a doorway/stair/ledge route; camera handles obstruction; rebind path exists.

tasks.title: Unified interaction contract
tasks.acceptance: Door and console use one focus/prompt contract; cancel/range loss/unload consume no action.

tasks.title: Mission state and stable IDs
tasks.acceptance: An authored job completes once, its IDs survive relaunch, duplicate reward request is harmless.

tasks.title: Save checkpoint and schema recovery
tasks.acceptance: Save roundtrip, corrupted latest save fallback, supported migration and unsupported version message tested.

tasks.title: Sunseed custody and charges
tasks.acceptance: Exactly one custodian survives interrupted transfer, death, reload; lease allocation separate from charges.

tasks.title: Free flight donor experiment
tasks.acceptance: Evaluate one candidate in isolation; record controller gap, license/AI restrictions, packaged behavior and removal path.

tasks.title: Owned assisted-flight controller
tasks.acceptance: Hover, strafe, brake and boost feel usable; collision recovery cannot strand the mission; controller supported.

tasks.title: Board and disembark safely
tasks.acceptance: Possession succeeds before input context changes; failed boarding preserves character and cargo state.

tasks.title: Sector transition readiness protocol
tasks.acceptance: Destination collision ready before commit; transforms, velocity and cargo preserved; timeout returns to safe state.

tasks.title: Orbit docking and return
tasks.acceptance: City-to-orbit-to-city route survives repeated travel, save and interrupted handoff.

tasks.title: Free art intake pilot
tasks.acceptance: One small asset selection passes scale/collision/material/license/memory and package checks.

tasks.title: Approved market block recipe
tasks.acceptance: One recipe supports walking, mission sightlines and ship approach; costs captured in packaged route.
tasks.progressNote: Packaged walking/flight/return checks and 1080p pacing passed. User-approved generated visual target remains unmet; retain this as active art work.

tasks.title: Service lease and return consequence
tasks.acceptance: Clinic versus evacuation lift decision is understandable; chosen outcome persists after returning and reload.

tasks.title: Guard perception and recoverable pursuit
tasks.acceptance: Sight/noise/evidence drive one guard; lost target is searched; detection leaves a valid completion route.

tasks.title: Single combat and flight interception
tasks.acceptance: One legible attack/counter and one flight interception can be completed with accessibility assists.

tasks.title: Accessible interaction and flight UI
tasks.acceptance: Subtitles, remap, sensitivity, hold-toggle and reduced motion work across both control contexts.

tasks.title: Audio readability and crew presence
tasks.acceptance: Dialogue, warning and power cues are intelligible; captions and volume categories work; source rights recorded.

tasks.title: Ten-minute expedition integration
tasks.acceptance: One packaged route connects ground, sunseed, ship, orbit and mandatory return with no progress blocker.

tasks.title: Performance and failure capture
tasks.acceptance: Fixed market/flight/return captures use documented settings; save/transfer failures recover; dominant bottleneck known.

tasks.title: External playtest and revision
tasks.acceptance: Unfamiliar players attempt route without coaching; observed problems drive one revision; no sales inference.

tasks.title: Prototype continuation decision
tasks.acceptance: Review enjoyment, performance, content throughput and remaining cost; choose repair, slice, smaller prologue or stop.

tasks.title: Define world library and source kit candidates
tasks.acceptance: World specification, at least 4000 planned briefs, sourced kit shortlist and physical-object/destruction contracts saved and reviewable.

tasks.title: Review and finish Second Dawn workshop frontage
tasks.acceptance: Actual matched in-game captures show coherent construction, materials and grounded objects; mission routes and packaged performance remain qualified.

tasks.title: Prove ten movable objects and persistent collection transfers
tasks.acceptance: Ten props carry, rotate, drop, throw, settle and save without duplication; a collection stub accepts or rejects transfers atomically; sunseed custody remains protected.

tasks.title: Qualify bounded prop and panel destruction
tasks.acceptance: Six material-specific breakables and one panel prove damage, bounded debris, content custody, persistent aftermath and performance; no citywide collapse commitment.
